resources.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
resources.detail: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space. Confirm the destination at the table.

afterLevel.detail: After the teleport, resistance to all damage lasts until the start of your next turn; this counter does not make that resistance permanent.

resources.name: Fey Step
resources.detail: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space.

afterLevel.detail: Apply the selected season’s rider. A required save is DC {featureDC}; Summer deals {pb} Fire, and Spring teleports a willing touched creature instead of you.

resources.name: Stone's Endurance
resources.detail: Reaction when damaged: roll 1d12 {conSign} and reduce that damage by the result. Resolve the reduction before applying damage.

resources.name: Giant Ancestry
resources.detail: Only the selected {optionName} power applies. {optionDetail} Confirm its target and trigger before recording a use.

optionDetails.cloud: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space.
optionDetails.fire: On a damaging attack-roll hit, add 1d10 Fire damage to that target.
optionDetails.frost: On a damaging attack-roll hit, add 1d6 Cold and reduce target Speed by 10 ft until your next turn starts.
optionDetails.hill: On a damaging attack-roll hit against a Large or smaller creature, knock that target Prone.
optionDetails.stone: Reaction when damaged: roll 1d12 {conSign} and reduce that damage by the result.
optionDetails.storm: Reaction after damage from a creature within 60 ft: deal 1d8 Thunder to that creature.

resources.name: Large Form

resources.name: Rabbit Hop
resources.detail: Bonus Action: jump {hop} ft without opportunity attacks. Requires Speed greater than 0; confirm a legal destination.

resources.name: Fey Gift
resources.detail: Use Help as a Bonus Action.

afterLevel.detail: Choose a rider for this Help: Hospitality grants each recipient 1d6 + {pb} temporary HP; Passage gives both +10 ft walking Speed until your next turn starts; Spite affects the helped creature’s next hit and its target’s next attack. Resolve recipients and duration separately.

resources.name: Fortune from the Many
resources.detail: After a missed attack or failed check/save, add the visible allies within 30 ft, to a maximum of +3. This does not permanently change rolls.

resources.name: Fury of the Small
resources.detail: After an attack/spell damages a larger creature, add {pb} damage. At most once per turn. Use New turn only after the turn changes (including another creature’s turn); this counter never adds damage to every attack.

resources.name: Shifting
resources.detail: Bonus Action; 1 minute. Gain {twicePB} temporary HP, keeping the higher pool. {optionName}: {optionDetail} Track duration and temporary benefits separately; end as a Bonus Action.

optionDetails.beasthide: Add 1d6 to the new temporary HP; gain +1 AC only while shifted.
optionDetails.longtooth: On activation and with later Bonus Actions while shifted, bite for 1d6 + STR Piercing. Resolve attacks separately.
optionDetails.swiftstride: While shifted, gain +10 ft Speed. Reaction: move up to 10 ft without opportunity attacks when a creature ends its turn within 5 ft.
optionDetails.wildhunt: While shifted, gain Advantage on Wisdom checks. Unless Incapacitated, attackers within 30 ft cannot have Advantage against you.
